name: assistant_bench_tiny
description: A very small, curated assistant evaluation set meant to test instruction-following, short-form generation, and basic question answering. It provides lightweight examples for rapid experimentation and model sanity checks rather than large-scale benchmarking. Best suited for quick local tests and model iteration.
evaluation_method: human_eval (supplemented by automated exact_match where applicable)
reputation: A tiny, community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption — mainly used for quick local checks and demos.
